name: gemm_mxfp4_n4096_k4096
description: MXFP4 dense GEMM C = A @ B.T (N=4096, K=4096). Inputs A and B are bf16 values pre-snapped to the MXFP4 (E2M1 data + UE8M0 block scale, block size 32) representable grid, so MXFP4 kernels are numerically exact against the high-precision reference.

A.description: Input activations on the MXFP4 grid.

B.description: Weight matrix on the MXFP4 grid (row-major, used as B.T).
